name: sortecerta
description: SorteCerta — mobile-first no-loss lottery on PoolTogether architecture, Web3-abstracted for non-crypto users.

scripts.keeper:morpho: cd packages/web && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm dlx tsx -e "const { default: run } = await import('./netlify/functions/morpho-keeper.ts'); await run();"
scripts.keeper:withdrawal: cd packages/web && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm dlx tsx -e "const { default: run } = await import('./netlify/functions/withdrawal-keeper.ts'); await run();"
scripts.keeper:all: npm run keeper:morpho && npm run keeper:withdrawal
